reason: A proposes a specific, testable grain-boundary-assisted chromium transport mechanism with a controlled intervention, baseline, passive-film measurements, and direct supporting evidence in ultrafine-grained stainless steels. B is comparatively generic and its assumption of a continuous Cr2O3 layer oversimplifies aqueous stainless-steel passive films, while broadly mixing acidic, saline, thermal-cycling, and irradiation regimes without adequate grounding.
